Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Your restaurant Custom Values:

Customer Referral Campaign Offer: Input the offer for your referral campaign. This will integrate into your referral offer workflow.

Google Review Link (Continuous Reputation Management): Insert the Google review link for yourrestaurant business. This link will facilitate continuous reputation management automation.

Google Review Link (Review Campaign): This is where you'll add the restaurant business's review link, which will be the same as the one mentioned above.

Holiday Email Offer: Customize the offer you wish to run within the 13 beautifully designed holiday emails.

2. Pipelines

Understanding Sales Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

In our snapshot, you'll find three distinct pipelines tailored to streamline your sales processes:

DR Campaign Pipeline: This pipeline is designed specifically for managing leads generated from your DR campaigns. It helps you track and nurture these leads through the various stages of the sales cycle until they convert into customers.

Review Campaign Pipeline:The review campaign pipeline allows you to see all of your review requests that were sent through your review campaign, allowing you to see how many left a review versus those who didn't.

Main Restaurant Leads Pipeline: The main restaurant leads pipeline serves as the central hub for managing all your restaurant-related leads. Whether they come from website forms, web chats, or other sources, this pipeline enables you to organize, track, and prioritize these leads effectively to maximize conversion opportunities.

With these three automated pipelines at your disposal, you can efficiently manage your sales activities, nurture leads, and drive revenue growth for the restaurant.

3. Calendars

Automated calendars are powerful tools that streamline scheduling processes, improve organization, and enhance productivity for businesses. They automate the process of booking appointments, managing service schedules, and coordinating activities, allowing businesses to efficiently allocate resources and provide exceptional service to their customers.

Automated Calendar for Restaurants

In our restaurant snapshot, you'll find a specialized automated calendar designed to simplify scheduling and streamline customer interactions:

Booking Request Calendar:

This calendar is dedicated to managing reservation requests and other appointments for your restaurant. It allows you to efficiently schedule table bookings, private dining events, and other reservations, ensuring smooth and reliable service delivery to your customers.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Understanding Appointment Automation

Automated appointment management systems streamline the process of scheduling, confirming, and managing appointments for businesses. By leveraging automation, businesses can enhance efficiency, improve customer communication, and reduce no-show rates, ultimately maximizing productivity and customer satisfaction.

Snapshot Appointment Automation for Restaurants

In our restaurant snapshot, we offer comprehensive automation for appointment confirmation, reminders, no-shows, and cancellations. Here's how it works:

Appointment Confirmation:When customers book a reservation through the Booking Request Calendar, they will receive an automated confirmation email or text message. This ensures that their reservation is successfully scheduled and confirmed, providing them with peace of mind and certainty.

Appointment Reminders:Prior to the scheduled reservation time, automated reminders will be sent to the customers. These reminders serve to minimize the risk of no-shows by prompting customers to confirm their attendance or make any necessary changes to their reservation.

No-show Management:In the unfortunate event of a no-show, the system will automatically tag the reservation accordingly. This allows restaurant staff to follow up with the customer, understand the reason for the absence, and potentially reschedule the reservation to minimize disruptions to the restaurant's schedule and workflow.

Cancellation Handling:If a customer cancels their reservation, the system will update their status accordingly. For instance, if a reservation is booked through the Booking Request Calendar, the customer's status will be updated as "reservation booked" in the pipeline. If they cancel, their status will be updated to "canceled." Similarly, if they fail to show up for the reservation, they will be marked as "no show" in the pipeline.

4. Restaurant Website Template

Snapshot Website Template Customization

The restaurant website template is designed to be easily customizable, allowing you to tailor it to fit your unique brand and business needs. Here's how you can make the most of this versatile template:

1. Add Your Logo:

Upload the restaurant’s logo to personalize the website and enhance brand recognition. The logo will seamlessly integrate into the design, giving your site a professional and cohesive look.

2. Customize Brand Colors:

Reflect the restaurant’s unique style by changing the brand colors. Choose from a wide range of color options to create a visually appealing and cohesive design that aligns with your restaurant's branding.

3. Edit Menus:

Easily update and display the restaurant’s menus. Add descriptions, prices, and images of your dishes to give customers a clear idea of what you offer. You can create multiple menus for different meal times or special occasions.

4. Update Content:

Tailor the content on your website to suit your specific business needs. Whether it's updating text, adding images, or modifying layouts, our user-friendly editor makes it simple to create compelling and engaging content that highlights your restaurant’s unique offerings.

Website Contact Us Form

Easily collect leads by utilizing a restaurant website form that will help you gather information about customers, including their name, email, phone number, and a comment.

Website Automations

If you navigate to the Automation tab, you will find a folder titled "Website Automations."

Inside the "Website Automations" folder, you will find three website automations.

Whenever someone interacts with your website form, webchat, or live chat, these automations will trigger. They will tag the lead, update their information in your pipeline, send them text and email follow-ups, and notify the restaurant that a new lead has been generated.

5. Link Trees

Linktrees are versatile tools that can significantly enhance your restaurant's online presence by providing a centralized hub for important links. They can be easily added to your restaurant’s social media profiles to collect leads, allow customers to book appointments, view menus, order online, and more. Here are four specialized linktrees included in our snapshot:

1. Free Appetizer Linktree:

This linktree is designed to attract new customers by offering a free appetizer. By clicking on the linktree, customers can claim their free appetizer and provide their contact information, which helps you collect leads and drive traffic to your restaurant.

2. Linktree - Call Us:

The Call Us linktree makes it easy for customers to get in touch with your restaurant. It features a direct call link, allowing customers to instantly connect with your restaurant for reservations, inquiries, or takeout orders. This streamlines communication and enhances customer convenience.

3. Restaurant Linktree:

This comprehensive linktree serves as a central hub for all essential restaurant links. Customers can use it to:

Book Appointments: Make reservations directly through your online booking system.

View Menu: Access your latest menu, including prices and descriptions of dishes.

Order Online: Place orders for delivery or takeout through your online ordering system.

Contact Us: Find all your contact information in one place, including phone number, email, and address. This linktree simplifies navigation for customers, making it easier for them to interact with your restaurant.

4. Restaurant Video Linktree:

The Restaurant Video Linktree showcases engaging video content related to your restaurant. Whether it’s a behind-the-scenes look at your kitchen, customer testimonials, or promotional videos, this linktree helps you connect with customers on a more personal level. It can also include links to:

Watch Videos: Access a collection of videos about your restaurant.

Book Appointments: Reserve a table after being inspired by your content.

View Menu: See what dishes are featured in the videos and explore your full menu.

Order Online: Place an order after watching mouth-watering videos of your dishes. This linktree enhances customer engagement by combining visual appeal with easy access to important links.

6. Funnels

Understanding Restaurant Funnels

Funnels are strategic marketing pathways designed to attract, engage, and convert potential customers into loyal patrons for your restaurant. These funnels guide prospects through a series of steps, from initial interest to taking action, ultimately driving them towards making a reservation or visiting your restaurant. In our snapshot, you'll find two specialized restaurant funnels that are easily customizable to suit your unique marketing objectives:

Free Dessert Funnel: This funnel is designed to entice new and returning customers by offering a free dessert with their meal. Here's how it works:

Landing Page: Customers are directed to a visually appealing landing page where they can claim their free dessert offer by providing their contact information.

Lead Capture: Once customers enter their details, they are added to your contact list, allowing you to follow up with personalized messages and offers.

Confirmation Page: After submitting their information, customers are taken to a confirmation page with instructions on how to redeem their free dessert when they visit your restaurant.

Customization Options: You can easily customize the text, images, and offer details on each page of the funnel using our user-friendly editor. Additionally, you can personalize the follow-up emails and messages to align with your restaurant's branding and communication style.

Free Appetizer Funnel: This funnel is designed to attract new customers by offering a free appetizer with their first meal. Here's how it works:

Landing Page: Customers land on an attractive page where they can sign up to receive a free appetizer by providing their contact information.

Lead Capture: After customers enter their details, they are added to your database, enabling you to send targeted promotions and updates.

Confirmation Page: Customers are directed to a confirmation page with details on how to redeem their free appetizer during their visit.

Customization Options: Each element of the funnel, from the landing page to the confirmation page, can be easily customized to match your restaurant’s branding. You can also tailor the follow-up communications to provide a seamless and engaging customer experience.

Funnel Automations:

Each funnel will be fully automated, with the name of each automation matching the corresponding funnel. Similarly, the funnel forms will be named identically for easy organization. When someone opts into a funnel, they will be seamlessly updated in the sales pipeline, tagged appropriately, and trigger an internal notification for you. Additionally, the lead will receive a personalized text and email with their offer upon opting in. If they proceed to book an appointment through the funnel, the appointment reminder automations will be triggered.

It's important to note that each automation and text message can be easily customized to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a cohesive and personalized experience for your leads.

7. 52 Week Nurture Campaigns

In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive 52-week email and text nurture campaigns designed to cultivate relationships with your leads and keep your restaurant top-of-mind. Here's what you can expect:

52-Week Email Nurture Campaign: This campaign consists of a series of weekly emails delivered to your restaurant leads over the course of a year. Each email contains valuable tips, industry insights, and exclusive offers tailored to their needs and interests. The goal of this campaign is to keep your restaurant front and center in the minds of your leads while providing them with ongoing value and engagement.

52-Week Text Nurture Campaign: Similarly, the 52-week text nurture campaign delivers weekly text messages to your restaurant leads, keeping them informed and engaged with your restaurant. These texts may include quick tips, special promotions, or reminders about upcoming events or services. The goal is to maintain regular communication with your leads through a convenient and accessible channel, fostering a sense of connection and trust.

Both campaigns are easily customizable, allowing you to tailor the content to reflect your restaurant's branding, voice, and specific offers. By leveraging these nurture campaigns, you can build strong relationships with your leads, encourage repeat visits, and increase customer loyalty.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the restaurant owner. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Email Workflow: The email workflow is activated when a lead reaches out via email. Similar to the GMB message workflow, it tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the restaurant, ensuring a prompt and efficient response to email inquiries.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the restaurant, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the restaurant owner, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

12. Reputation Management

Reputation management is crucial for maintaining a positive image and credibility for your restaurant business. It involves actively monitoring and influencing how your brand is perceived by customers, both online and offline. In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive reputation management features to help you proactively manage and enhance your online reputation.

Snapshot Reputation Management Features

Ongoing Reputation Management: After each service, customers have the option to request a review. This process allows you to gather feedback and testimonials from satisfied customers, helping to boost your online reputation and credibility.

Google Review Campaign: Our Google review campaign is designed to generate a significant number of new reviews for the restaurant owner. You can input a list of existing customers into the campaign to kickstart the process, resulting in 30-100 new reviews right away. Customers in this campaign are managed through a dedicated review campaign pipeline, allowing you to track who has left a review and who hasn't.

Key Features and Customization Options

Custom Review Links: The review link for both ongoing reputation management and the Google review campaign can be customized using custom values. This allows you to tailor the review links to your branding and preferences.

Trigger Links: Each campaign includes two trigger links that serve as indicators of customer engagement. These trigger links, associated with the review custom value links, help you track whether customers have clicked on the review links or not, if clicked they will no longer get review reminders and so on.

13. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact the restaurant owner but were unable to connect via phone. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider the restaurant.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
